paper_title: An Investigation of the Recoverable Robust Assignment Problem
classifications: Theory of computation → Fixed parameter tractability
statement: The case with costs c2 that are not polynomially bounded remains open. But note, that an RNC algorithm for this problem would imply an RNC algorithm for the special case of obtaining a minimum cost perfect matching, which is a long standing open problem [7].
context: This completes the reduction as claimed in the theorem. Note that this reduction can be implemented using logarithmic space.
